notes.title: Update 1.0.8 - new map
notes.content:
Today I'm excited to introduce a new map.
There are many new challenges in this tricky parkour, so don't fall off, guys.

Since there are some new elements in this map that are prone to lag, I've added some tweaks for this map to improve the multiplayer experience. If these features work well, I will add them to all other maps as well.

Michael

notes.title: Update 1.0.7 - Bug fixes
notes.content:
Thank you for all your feedback and bug reports, I am working to address them all.

With version 1.0.7 I have taken care of display problems when playing with many players.
When I introduced the 32 player cap, I didn't think anyone would play with that many players, but you guys did :-)

So here are the fixes for lobby and endscreen.

[list]
[*] Fix: Lobby and endscreen list cannot hold more than 8 players
[*] Fix: Ping in lobby incorrect
[*] Fix: FOV and Gamma not always applied
[*] Improve downtown map respawn location
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 - new years map
notes.content:
I wish you all a happy new year. 
To celebrate the new year a little, I've added a small new map with lots of fireworks.
Thank you to everyone who supports me, I really appreciate it.

Have fun and see you next year.

Michael
